sources.chain: CBOE delayed quotes (cdn.cboe.com), morning run: bid, ask, OI, IV per contract
sources.implied_vol: each contract's own IV from the CBOE feed; market measure uses the at-the-money IV of the expiry
sources.historical_vol: 30-day close-to-close realised vol from Yahoo daily closes (iv_em.json rv30_pct)

method: Tournament: shorts at 25-45 delta, longs at 5-20 delta, every combination, tiers 25-45 and 45-95 DTE. EV = P(win) x average win - P(loss) x average loss at exits of 25, 18 and 10 DTE, after a quarter-spread slippage per leg in and out and $0.65 per contract per leg in and out. Ranked by market-probability EV per dollar of max loss; historical-vol EV shown beside it. Negative EVs are kept.
